I noticed weeknights can be quiet, and I'd love to play a set that could help draw people in on a slower night. Would you be open to a quick reply or call about a weeknight date? Thanks for your time either way.

draft.subject: Following up on live music at Quill and Ale
draft.body: Hi Sam, I sent a note on November 9 about live music at Quill and Ale and wanted to follow up in case it got buried. I know weeknights can be quiet, and I'd be glad to talk through whether a weeknight set could help bring in more people. Would you be open to a quick call or a short reply about whether that's worth exploring? Thanks for your time.
